title: Implement slugify with Vietnamese diacritics
prompt: Implement slugify(text) in slugify.js. It must lowercase the text, remove Vietnamese and other Latin diacritics (đ becomes d), turn every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 into a single dash, and trim dashes from both ends. An input with no letters or digits returns an empty string. The tests in test.js describe the expected behaviour; do not change test.js.
